content.text: Tigers-Wings will be an interesting follow nowadays with these events being cancelled etc. Anything left up to Chris I will go on as normal. Decisions will have to come down from league level.
Why are they playing spring training games with a lot of elderly people in attendance
Especially when it isn’t that important
MLB is on deck
Yep
Lions and Pistons employees working remotely. Tigers and Wings people told to operate “business as usual”
Ridiculous
Lol at me asking Al if they were gonna pay for the non-salary employees
Did you really ask him? There’s no chance. They may cut the salaried people
Yeah
https://twitter.com/anthonyfenech/status/1238250670932844544?s=12
Lol. Too bad Chris isn’t there this week
If you think about it, Wings employees are being forced to work in a building that had confirmed cases of coronavirus. I don’t think that’s true of anyone else
Now all schools closed 3 weeks. Unreal. We can’t have a high school baseball practice even.
It’s crazy that it’s been determined our lives are at stake to the point where kids can’t go to school and pro sports can’t happen
Frightening. I wasn’t worried in any way 3 days ago
And yet wings employees are supposed to make sales calls from the office
Me neither. And I don’t think the worst of it has hit yet.
Someone there had it?

Good point
And just practically speaking who the hell is going to buy anything?

Hell if I know

I saw Duane down here
Barely recognized him with his beard
It’s pretty thick

Might be easier to talk to him now
Yeah.... Do you think MHSAA will play the spring sports out?
I’m hoping they just take a break for a couple weeks and reevaluate. What college baseball did is crazy to me. Why cancel the college World Series NOW?
Dude I know
I have been feeling awful for those kids all night, like 5th year senior guys or draft guys
Just seniors in general, across the board
But for baseball, it’s like they barely got off the ground in their season
I don’t understand why they couldn’t just pause for a while
